title: Jones et al. (1986) reported average d-t yield X_mu ~ 150

provenance.locator: Jones et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 56, 588 (1986)
provenance.input_basis: BLOCKED: the ~150 fusions-per-muon average comes from a specific operating point within the Jones LAMPF campaign. The primary (Phys. Rev. Lett. 56, 588) has since been read: p.591, in the paragraph before the summary, states that average for a liquefied d-t target with c_t = 0.3, and the 20-500 K temperature range it states on p.589 belongs to its fit for lambda_dt, the dmu -> tmu muon-transfer rate -- but it states no (T, phi) for that operating point itself, so that pair still cannot be pinned. Per the never-guess rule, conditions are left empty and the case is registered but not run.
